method.percentiles: per-run nearest rank with ceil(p*n); displayed to 0.001 ms
method.apkFrameIntervals: 299 adjacent Choreographer callback timestamps inside each 300-row measured window
method.h5FrameIntervals: 300 rAF intervals, with the last warm-up callback as first predecessor
method.apkSubmission: CPU time around JNI draw on GL thread
method.h5Admission: wait for previous shared-host GPU retirement before requesting rAF
method.apkAdmission: one outstanding command packet; next callback requested after GL thread acknowledges submission on UI
method.liveBridge: request to Java bytes ready; JS-local self time includes scene, capture, encoding and Base64; residual is computed per sample and includes scheduling, transport and Java decode/copy
method.h5Startup: navigation or scene initialization to first host submit return; navigation to first host.whenIdle resolution
method.apkStartup: process or Activity to UI callback acknowledging first GL-thread draw; excludes display presentation
method.nativeMemory: host PSS after final pixel readback/GL release and before JS lease close; excludes isolated WebView renderer
method.h5Memory: Chrome browser PID PSS before/after timing and before readback/close; includes unrelated browser state, excludes renderer and GPU processes

resident.collection: separate residency runs; outside formal CPU/cadence timing
resident.chromeRendererAttribution: Owned page performance.mark traced to one OS PID, checked against CDP renderer and Android Chrome sandboxed process, PSS from dumpsys meminfo --local
